verdict.rationale: LangGraph and its Agent Server platform could reasonably offer scoped API credentials, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents issuing API keys, scopes, or least-privilege credentials for an agent. The OpenAPI, CLI, and deployment docs cover runs, threads, assistants and versioning, but none mention credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
